question: For order 423, identify the product IDs, aisles, and positions from which to pick the exact quantities needed for each order line, ensuring that the total picked quantity for each product matches the cumulative quantities ordered without exceeding the available inventory in warehouse 1. Calculate the quantities to be picked from each location by prioritizing inventory with earlier purchased dates and smaller quantities, and ensure that picking respects the sequence and cumulative quantities of the order lines for products with multiple entries.
sql:
WITH order_lines AS (
    SELECT order_id, product_id, qty, id AS orderline_id
    FROM orderlines
    WHERE order_id = 423
),
inventory_with_location AS (
    SELECT i.id AS inv_id, i.location_id, i.product_id, i.qty AS avail_qty, l.warehouse, l.aisle, l.position, p.purchased
    FROM inventory i
    JOIN locations l ON i.location_id = l.id
    JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id = p.id
    WHERE l.warehouse = 1
),
ranked_inventory AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY purchased, avail_qty) AS rn
    FROM inventory_with_location
),
cumulative_inventory AS (
    SELECT ri.*,
           SUM(ri.avail_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY ri.product_id ORDER BY ri.purchased, ri.avail_qty ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_avail
    FROM ranked_inventory ri
),
product_ordered AS (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(qty) AS total_ordered
    FROM order_lines
    GROUP BY product_id
),
pick_plan AS (
    SELECT ci.inv_id, ci.location_id, ci.product_id, ci.aisle, ci.position, ci.purchased, ci.avail_qty, ci.cum_avail, po.total_ordered,
           CASE 
               WHEN ci.cum_avail <= po.total_ordered THEN ci.avail_qty
               WHEN ci.cum_avail > po.total_ordered THEN po.total_ordered - (ci.cum_avail - ci.avail_qty)
           END AS picked_qty
    FROM cumulative_inventory ci
    JOIN product_ordered po ON ci.product_id = po.product_id
    WHERE ci.cum_avail <= po.total_ordered
       OR (ci.cum_avail > po.total_ordered AND (ci.cum_avail - ci.avail_qty) < po.total_ordered)
)
SELECT product_id, aisle, position, picked_qty
FROM pick_plan
ORDER BY product_id, purchased, position
